targetText: One use-value is not exchanged for the very same use-value.
explanation: Key theoretical concept in Ch. 1 as per First German Edition: Marxists analyze how structural economic conditions determine political and social relations under capitalism.

targetText: Social form of the commodity and value-form or form of exchangeability are thus one and the same thing.
explanation: Modern relevance: understanding these underlying systemic dynamics helps clarify contemporary economic policies and labor movements.
